domains.name: PVD / Sputtering Physics & Practice
domains.scope: The physics and practical operation of sputter deposition of gold: plasma generation, target erosion, film nucleation and growth on moving wire, and the process parameters that set rate, coverage, adhesion and gold-usage efficiency. Owns the coating-process half of Q1/Q2 (what deposition conditions the machine must sustain) and the sputtering side of the cheapest-vs-best route comparison (Q6). Vacuum-generating hardware (pumps, chamber build, feedthrough seals) belongs to the vacuum-machine-build domain; wet electroplating chemistry belongs to the electroplating domain.
